New York City Pauses AI Use for Younger Students

New York City has imposed a one-year moratorium on student-facing generative artificial intelligence tools for students up to the eighth grade. The ban, effective for the 2026-27 academic year, was announced by Mayor Eric Adams and Schools Chancellor David Banks. This decision follows similar actions by other major US school districts, including Los Angeles, which has blocked access to generative AI for all its students. The move aims to address concerns about the impact of AI on education and student learning.
